verdict_reason: The one-line addition is correct, but it adds a second name for 403, which statusCodes.forbidden in common/constants/status-codes.js already names.

todos.issue: HTTP_STATUS_FORBIDDEN = 403 adds a second name for a value the repo already names: src/server/common/constants/status-codes.js:7 has 'forbidden: 403' (statusCodes.forbidden, used by common/helpers/errors.js:7). The PR widens the existing split between lib/http-status.js and common/constants/status-codes.js (both already name 400, 404, 413, 500) rather than reusing the owner of 403; its one caller is get-fulfilment.js:21.
todos.fix: Must: 403 has one named home in the frontend, and get-fulfilment.js reads it from there. One way: drop HTTP_STATUS_FORBIDDEN and import statusCodes.forbidden (and statusCodes.notFound) in get-fulfilment.js; folding the two status modules into one is a follow-up for the wider split.
